chapter_title: Concerning the living Fire: It is present in Eight Places.
chapter_note: After a brief hagiographic/dialogue-style incipit naming “the apostle,” the chapter is dominated by a systematic eightfold cosmological placement of the Living Fire (Land of Light, Father, First Man/Perfect Man, the day-ship, night light-giver, Living Spirit’s body, new earth/foundation-course, and an eschatological manifestation). No pastoral/institutional extension and no NT citation overlay are present; the core layer reads as an impersonal enumerative map.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Dialogue/frame attribution with “Once again” + “the apostle speaks” is a compilation wrapper; it introduces the topic rather than expounding the system.

paragraphs.core_text: The first place wherein it is, is this [light] land [where it is present and] exists. It is established beneath [it ... ut]terly beyond the totality. It is the foundation and ba]sis of that great earth, and the consideratio[n th]at is beneath them all.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Impersonal, systematic ‘first place’ cosmological topography; no citation or institutional address.

paragraphs.core_text: The second place wherein it is, is the Father, the God of truth; because [the Fathe]r is established in his great, mighty consideration. So, [firs]t in the Father. The other powers that came from him were revealed through him, and (the fire) too came w[i]th them [and was revea]led by them.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic placement in the Father with emanational logic (“powers that came from him”); expository voice characteristic of the teaching layer.

paragraphs.core_text: The third [place wherein it is], is the First Man, h[e] wh[o ... ... ] armour. Again, it is this fire [ ... ... ] on the body of the Perfect Man.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Named Manichaean cosmic beings used in structural enumeration (third place), not narrative anecdote; fits old cosmological mapping.

paragraphs.core_text: [The fourth is this fir]e that was purified from all the [light] powers, [which is i]n the outer wall, in the ship of the day.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Enumerative fourth term; cosmological geography (outer wall; day-ship).

paragraphs.core_text: [The fifth i]s this fire that is in the light-giver of the night [ ... ] within the water.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continuation of the eightfold list with cosmic vessel/light-body imagery; no frame markers.

paragraphs.core_text: [The] sixth is this f[i]re that is purified from the totality. The Living [Spirit] swathed it upon his body, over the summons and the obedience. He has established many things by it. He went down and stripped himself of it before the Por[t]er.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic process description (swathing/stripping) with standard Manichaean agents (Living Spirit, Porter; summons/obedience) in expository form.

paragraphs.core_text: The seventh is this living fire that is of the new earth, and is the consideration. For it is the first foundation in the new earth, it they built anew [ ... ... ] the first course, that is a crown for the entire earth. T[hey] are below the totality, over the entire earth of da[rkne]ss [ ... ] in it, in the [ ... ] whole [ ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic eschatological/cosmological architecture (new earth; foundation/course/crown) continues the numbered schema; impersonal descriptive register.

paragraphs.core_text: [The] eigh[th] is the fire that shall be revealed in this [ ... ... ] person, and it signifies fear and war. Furthermore it [ ... ] it displays and manifests its sign in [its ter]ror. It shall be r[ev]ealed in these two light ships.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Eighth term completes the enumerative set with eschatological ‘shall be revealed’ language tied to light ships; no NT entry-vector or institutional seam.

paragraphs.core_text: This i[s the way] that the holy living fire exists in these [eight places].
paragraphs.temporal_note: Formal summation closing the systematic list; not a doxology or community-response frame.
